implementation: Existing SQLite publication outbox and chain-neutral dispatcher
schedule: min(max_delay, initial_delay * 2^(retry_number-1)) times bounded jitter; final delay capped at max_delay
persistence: retry_count, available_at, last_failure_class and last_failure_code are stored with the existing outbox row and survive SQLite reopen.

classification.transient_pre_submission: healthcheck or preparation is unavailable; keep queued/retryable and schedule a bounded retry
classification.safe_retry: new signed attempt only after an adapter explicitly proves safe_to_retry
classification.ambiguous_submission: preserve UNKNOWN and the exact persisted signed attempt; do not call it failed
classification.receipt_pending: retain unresolved evidence; schedule another observation
classification.permanent_failure: terminal local/configuration/payload failure only when no persisted attempt exists
classification.manual_intervention: retry limit, expired Solana blockhash, conflicting verification, or local error after an attempt; preserve uncertainty/receipts

reconciliation: Reconciliation can observe during backoff, but signed payload replay is gated by the persisted available_at due time.
